issues.title: 1 mm bottom chamfer
issues.message: Recommend adding 1mm chamfer to the base of all parts for maximum reliability and highest tolerance.

issues.title: No text on the bottom
issues.message: The bottom face has 4 small shapes cut into or raised from it — likely text or a logo. Fine detail on the bed side prints poorly and can make the part rock.
issues.suggestion: Move text and logos to a side or the top of the part, or make the lettering at least 2 mm wide.

issues.title: Potential Excessive Support
issues.message: Estimated support is about 490% of the part's volume (177.1 cm³ of support for 36.1 cm³ of part). Highlighted areas overhang 35° or less from horizontal.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part to reduce overhangs, add chamfers under overhangs, or split it into pieces that print flat.

issues.title: Requires Support
issues.message: About 2605 mm² of overhangs (35° or less from horizontal) will need support. Highlighted areas show where.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part so fewer surfaces face downward, or add chamfers under overhangs.

issues.title: No thin vertical stalks
issues.message: A column about 1.8 mm wide and 17.0 mm tall (9.6× taller than wide) may wobble while printing and snap off during handling.
issues.suggestion: Thicken the column to at least 2 mm, add a fillet or brace at its base, or print it lying down.
